_meta.note: Vendored snapshot of eval-card-registry canonical entries. Regenerate with python -m every_eval_ever.tools.refresh_eval_card_registry. Do not edit by hand. Derived, not a verbatim mirror: org spellings are recorded twice, once case-folded and once also punctuation-stripped, so a consumer can tell a recorded identifier from a spelling that only collapses onto one; an alias is dropped when it restates an identity or points at two organizations. Authoritative at snapshot time: entries added to the registry later resolve here only after a refresh.
